question: The asteroid belt lies between which two planets?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mars and Jupiter**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Asteroids have their orbits between Mars and Jupiter. In the past, planets and their moons have existed between Mars and Jupiter in the asteroid belt.
 
• They were destroyed in some kind of affliction. The asteroids belt could be their scattered remains. Hence, the combined gravitational force of Jupiter and Mars accelerates the moving of the asteroids around them.
 
• Ceres, Vesta, Pallas and Hygiea are few names of Asteroids.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Solar System has four terrestrial planets: Mercury, Venus, Earth, and Mars. These are also inner planets.
 
• The Solar System has four outer planets: Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune.
